# Every form of GNU's m68k opcode table that the ColdFire 54455 (ISA_C) has and no CPU
# before it in tools/fuzz/m68k.py's CORPUS_ORDER does, one line each, with
# operands that form takes and no earlier form of the mnemonic does.
# Motorola syntax, checked against GNU as --mri.
#
#   tools/fuzz/m68k.py corpus --first --cpu 54455 --syntax mot

	bitrev	d2
	byterev	d1
	ff1	d4
	stldsr	#1
